title: Banished King
description:
Name: [Maledictus](image:tumblrbumblr:textures/quests/photos/maledictus.png:150:150)
Known Locations: The Frosted Prison, found in the Eternal Frosthold, accessed through an Eye of Curse.
Estimated Size: Large
Behavior: Maledictus is rageful, shown through a meter under his health bar. When he lands an attack, his rage builds, and when an attack misses, his rage lessens. His attacks become stronger the more rageful he is. At close range, he dual wields Phantom Maces and can generate shockwaves. At mid-range, he wields a Phantom Halberd, allowing for more mobility and summoning spectral halberds in large areas. At long range, he uses the Phantom Bow, capable of shooting 4 homing projectiles. Maledictus's arms have rings around them revealing if his next attack will be blockable. If green, they are blockable; if orange, they can be blocked but will disable shield; and if red, they cannot be blocked.
Danger Level: §8§lDeadly, spatial awareness is crucial
